title: Simple Past: Regular and Irregular Verbs / Uko gucika kuri: amagambo y’ingenzi n’amagambo atandukanye
bridge: Mu gaciri, uko gucika kuri kigamwaho n’amagambo y’ingenzi (hablé, comí, viví). Mu Icyongereza, amagambo y’ingenzi ahinyura -ed (talk → talked), ariko amagambo menshi y’ibinyacumu ari atandukanye kandi ahagaze (go → went). Uretse ho, mu Icyongereza ako karorero kigeza ku buri wese (I went, you went, he went), kandi mu gaciri bihagaze (fui, fuiste, fue). Menya neza ntukoreshe ‘did’ mu magambo yo kwinjira!
rule: Uko gucika kuri mu Icyongereza bikoreshwa kugena ibikorwa byatanzwe mu gihe cy’inyuma. Kuri amagambo y’ingenzi, -ed bihishurwa (work → worked, play → played). N’iyo igambo kigamwaho na ‘e’, -d gusa bihishurwa (live → lived); n’iyo kigamwaho na imvugo + ‘y’, ‘y’ bihindura kuva ‘i’ kandi -ed bihishurwa (study → studied). Amagambo atandukanye afite ibyakozwe byagiye (see → saw, eat → ate) byo wabimenyesha. Mu gutangira n’ibibazo, ‘did’ bikoreshwa + igambo mu buryo bwayo bw’ingenzi (I didn’t go, Did you see?). Uko kwinjira ntibikoresha ‘did’. Uko gucika kuri bikoreshwa n’amagambo nk’ ‘yesterday’, ‘last week’, ‘in 2010’.

title: Present Progressive (Igihe cy’ububiko)
bridge: Mu gishimikire, igihe cy’ububiko (am/is/are + ingabo -ing) bikoreshwa kuri ibikorwa bifite ububiko ubu canke mu gihe kirekire ubu. Mu ikinyarwanda, tukurora igihe cy’ubwenge kuri ibintu bibiri (''nzagiye ngira'' vs ''ngira''). Ubwanya bw’ibintu bimeze ni ukwo abanyarwanda bakabura ingabo z’igikorwa ''to be'' canke bakabujija igihe bashobora gukoresha igihe cy’ubwenge cyangwa cy’ububiko. Ahubwo kandi mu gishimikire, harimo ubwigenge buhuzaho ubw’ibikorwa bifite ububiko (present simple) n’ibikorwa bifite ububiko (present continuous).
rule: Igihe cy’ububiko bikozwe n’ingabo z’igikorwa ''to be'' zikoranye (am, is, are) + ingabo z’igikorwa k’intangiriro zifite -ing. Bikoreshwa kuri: 1) ibikorwa bifite ububiko mu gihe wigeze ubwira (''I am reading now''), 2) ibikorwa bifite ububiko bishikana n’ubu (''She is working in Madrid these days''), na 3) ibitekerezo by’ubutaka (''We are meeting at 5''). Ntibikoreshwa n’ibigirwamana by’ubwenge (like, want, know, prefer) usibye mu bihe bitandukanye. Uburyo bw’ubwenge bwinjira ''not'' nyuma y’ingabo z’igikorwa (''I am not sleeping''), na uburyo bw’ibicenye bishyiramo ingabo z’igikorwa (''Are you listening?''). Mu ikinyarwanda, igihe cy’ububiko (kuba + ingabo z’ububiko) ni nk’ibyo, ariko mu gishimikire bikoreshwa kuruta mu ikinyarwanda, neza kuri ibikorwa bifite ububiko.

common_error.explanation: Iyi ngororero ifite ubwanya kuko mu ikinyarwanda ntibishyirwamo ingabo z’ububiko z’igikorwa (''ngira'' vs ''nzagiye ngira''). title: Future with going to /  'Going to' kugena ubuturo
bridge: Mu gaciriyano, kugena ubuturo dusaba ubwoko bw'imparafuze mu gihe cyoroheje ('bya mbere nzajya ku kino') cyangwa 'genda aha + infinitive' ('bya mbere nzajya ku kino'). Mu Icyongereza, ubwoko 'be going to + umubare' ni ukwiyunguraho kw'ibyivugwa n'ubwoko 'genda aha + infinitive', ariko bihawe umubabaro mukubiyambe: mu Icyongereza ntitwa neza ushyiramo umubare 'to be' (am/is/are) mbere y' 'going to', ibyo atari byo mu gaciriyano. Nanone, 'going to' bushyirwa mu bipimo bya kubaho n'iby'ubushakashatsi, ariko atibishywa mu kwakira ibintu byagenewe ku byerekeye ubu (mu bihe bishitse bushyirwa 'will').
rule: Kugena ubuturo n'ubwoko 'going to', bushyirwa: umuntu + umubare 'to be' (am/is/are) + 'going to' + umubare mu rusange. Mu kwakira: 'I am going to travel' (nzajya gufika). Mu kwishyura: 'I am not going to travel' (si nzajya gufika). Mu kwibaza: 'Are you going to travel?' (woba ufika?). Birahishuwe kandi: 'I'm going to', 'You're going to', niyo ibindi. Bushyirwa mu: 1) Ibipimo bya kubaho n'iby'ubushakashatsi (nzajya kugura ikinyabwoya), 2) Kwakira ibintu byagenewe ku byerekeye ubu (reba ibiyaga! Ibyuma byajya kuba). Atibishywa mu gushyirwa mu makubye yishyuwe (mu bihe bishitse bushyirwa 'will': 'I'll help you'). Remera ko 'going to' atahinduka, 'to be' ni ukwo kuri gihe.

title: Simple Future (will) / Ubusabe bwihariye (will)
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugirango tusuzume iby’ubusabe, tubikora ubusabe bwihariye (nzica, nzajya) cyangwa ubwoko bw’amagambo ‘kujya ku + infinitif’. Mu Icyongereza, ubusabe bwihariye bwinshi kuri buri kintu ni ‘will + ingingo y’umwimerere’, idontaye ntabwo ifitiye umuntu. Ahubwo mu gaciri, nta miko y’ubwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi kuri buri kintu kuri buri umuntu; ingingo y’umwimerere irahura. Ibibazo bihambaye ni ukwibuka ko nyuma y’ ‘will’ bikorwa ingingo y’umwimerere y’umwimerere, bitandukanye ‘to’ cyangwa ‘-s’ mu kanya k’umuntu.
rule: Ubusabe bwihariye bw’ ‘will’ bukomotswe n’umuntu + will (cyangwa ubwoko bw’amagambo ‘ll) + ingingo y’umwimerere mu mwanya w’umwimerere. Nta miko y’ubwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi kuri buri kintu kuri buri umuntu (he will go, she will go, we will go). Kugira ngo usubize, bikorwa will not (won't). Kugira ngo ubaze, ubwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi kuri buri kintu bukorwa: Will + umuntu + ingingo y’umwimerere y’umwimerere. ‘Will’ bikorwa kugira ibitekerezo by’ubusabe, ibitekerezo, amasezerano, ibyishimo n’ibitekerezo by’ubusabe. Nanone bikorwa n’ibimenyetso by’igihe cy’ubusabe nk’ejo, inyandiko y’icyuma, byumvi, n.a. Mu bwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi kuri buri kintu, ubwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi kuri buri kintu ni ‘will not’ n’ubwoko bw’amagambo ni ‘won't’.

title: Comparatives and Superlatives / Ibyunguza n’ibyunguza cyane
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugira ngo tubyunguze n’ibyunguza cyane, tubika ‘más’ na ‘menos’ mu buryo bungana (más alto, el más alto). Mu Icyongereza, harimo ibirimo bibiri: ku byo kuri ibyigwa bitandukanye (igice kimwe, ahubwo kabiri) bishyirwaho ‘-er’ na ‘-est’ (tall → taller → tallest), kandi ku byo kuri ibyigwa bikubiyemo (igice ebyiri cyangwa cyane) bishimishwa ‘more’ na ‘most’ (beautiful → more beautiful → most beautiful). Ikibazo kihambaye: ntukabire ‘more tall’ kuri ‘más alto’ — byiza cyane mu Icyongereza. Nanone, mu byunguza cyane byegereje ‘the’ (the tallest), nyamara mu gaciri, ‘el’ bishobora kugwa.
rule: Ku byunguza by’ububiko: Ibyigwa bitandukanye (igice kimwe na by’igice ebyiri nk’ ‘happy’, ‘simple’) byongerejwe ‘-er’ (fast → faster). Ibyigwa bikubiyemo (igice ebyiri cyangwa cyane) byerekana ‘more’ (more expensive). Ku byunguza cyane: ‘-est’ (the fastest) cyangwa ‘most’ (the most expensive). Ibyigwa by’igice ebyiri bya kugwa aha -y byarundikwa -ier na -iest (happy → happier → happiest). Ibindi bisabunzira: good/well → better → best; bad → worse → worst; far → farther/further → farthest/furthest. ‘Than’ byerekana byunguza (She is taller than me) na ‘the’ + byunguza cyane (He is the best). ‘More’ ntibishimishwa na ‘-er’, cyangwa ‘most’ na ‘-est’.

title: Modal Verbs: must, have to, should
bridge: Mu gacanyi, tubika amagambo ‘gushaka’, ‘gushaka kugirango’ n’ ‘gushaka kuba’ kugirango tusuzume ububiko n’ubushake, ariko mu gacanyi, amagambo ya modal verbs yihinduka cyane cyane kandi yihinduka kuri buri muntu n’igihe. Hano, ‘must’ na ‘have to’ ni byatanze ariko bifite ibyerekana byinshi mu kuri ububiko bwo mu mutwe n’ububiko bwo hagati y’abantu, kandi ‘should’ bikoreshwa kugirango dusuzume ubushake. Kanga ubwoba: mu gacanyi, amagambo ya modal verbs ntibikwiye kugirwa ‘s’ kuri wundi muntu kandi bikurikirwa n’igisubizo cy’igikorwa nti ‘to’.
rule: Amagambo ya modal verbs mu gacanyi bikoreshwa kugirango tusuzume ububiko (must, have to), ubushake (should) n’ubushakashatsi (need to). Kugirango dusuzume amagambo, tubika: umuntu + modal + igikorwa mu buryo bwo kwinjira (nti ‘to’, usibye ‘have to’ na ‘need to’ bikwiye kugirwa ‘to’). ‘Must’ bisuzuma ububiko bwo mu mutwe cyangwa ububiko bwinshi, ‘have to’ bisuzuma ububiko bwo hagati y’abantu, kandi ‘should’ bisuzuma ubushake. Mu gahinda: must not (mustn't) kugirango tusuzume ubwigenge, don't/doesn't have to kugirango tusuzume ko nta bushakashatsi, kandi shouldn't kugirango tusuzume ubushake bwo mu gahinda. Mu ibyibazo, tubika modal na umuntu: 'Should I...?' cyangwa 'Do I have to...?'. Nta ‘must’ itari mu kagara; tubika ‘had to’. ‘Have to’ bikoreshwa mu kwinjira, mu kagara (had to) n’mu mbere (will have to). ‘Should’ ni byatanze mu kagara ariko tubika ‘should have + past participle’ kugirango tusuzume ubwubaka, nyamara ibyo ni mu mpanuro ya B1.

title: Reflexive Verbs / Imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira
bridge: Mu gaciri, dushtuka neza imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira (me levanto, me baño), ariko mu Icyongereza, ibyiterere birenga. Akenshi, ibyo mu gaciri ari imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira, mu Icyongereza biravugwa n’umwuka w’urupfu (I get up, I shower). Nanone, mu Icyongereza, amajambo yo kwishyura (myself, yourself, etc.) ntishimwa igihe cyose, kandi ntibifasha n’imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira mu gaciri. Menya gutanga ‘me’ nk’uko ari mu Icyongereza, kubera ko ‘me’ ni gikenewe, si imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira.
rule: Mu Icyongereza, imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira igendeshwa n’umwuka w’urupfu + igisubirizo cy’umuntu (myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves). Imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira ishtakwa igihe umuntu akora n’akagira. Ariko mu byoroshye, imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira mu gaciri ntishimwa igisubirizo cy’umuntu mu Icyongereza: get up, wake up, shave, shower, dress, feel, etc. Imisubirizo: I get up at seven (si ‘I get myself up’). I feel happy (si ‘I feel myself happy’). Amajambo yo kwishyura ashobora kugirwa kugabanya: I did it myself. Kuri mwigeme w’A2, gahunda kuri imyiterere y’ibyo umuntu akora akagira ishtakwa neza: imyiterere y’ibintu by’umunsi (get up, wash, dress) n’amagambo nk’ ‘enjoy oneself’ cyangwa ‘behave oneself’. Remera ko ‘myself’ ntishimwa nk’umuntu; mu Icyongereza dushtuka ‘I’.

title: Object Pronouns / Imyaka y’ibyo gushyirwa n’ibyo gushyirwa
bridge: Mu gaciri, imyaka y’ibyo gushyirwa n’ibyo gushyirwa (me, te, lo/la, le, nos, os, les) bikorwa inyuma y’umubare, ariko mu Icyongereza, imyaka y’ibyo gushyirwa (me, you, him, her, it, us, them) bikorwa inyuma y’umubare cyangwa inyuma y’ijambo ry’urupapuro. Nanone, mu gaciri, harimo ubwoko bw’ibyo gushyirwa n’ibyo gushyirwa kuri lo/la na le, ariko mu Icyongereza, him/her/them bikoreshwa kuri buri bimwe, usibye kuri ibyo gushyirwa by’urupapuro bishobora gutanga ‘to’ cyangwa ‘for’. Kanga ubwoba: mu Icyongereza nta n’ubundi ubworoshye umutwe ugomba kugirwa nk’uko bikorwa mu gaciri, kandi ntukoreshe ‘lo’ nk’uko ‘it’ kuri ibyo gushyirwa.
rule: Imyaka y’ibyo gushyirwa mu Icyongereza ni: me, you, him, her, it, us, them. Bikoreshwa kugirango gushyirwe ho igitabo cy’umubare (kirangwa n’igishushanyo) cyangwa ibyo gushyirwa (kirangwa n’ibyo gushyirwa). Bikorwa inyuma y’umubare (I see him) cyangwa inyuma y’ijambo ry’urupapuro (She gives it to me). Ntibishyira ku buryo bw’umubare (him/her kuri abantu, it kuri ibintu, them kuri inyandiko). Kuri ibyo gushyirwa, uburyo ‘umubare + ibyo gushyirwa + ijambo ry’urupapuro’ (She gave the book to him) cyangwa ‘umubare + ijambo ry’urupapuro + ibyo gushyirwa’ (She gave him the book) bushobora kugirwa. Ku bw’ishushanyo n’igaciri, nta mutwe w’imyaka w’ibyo gushyirwa w’ibyo gushyirwa w’ibyo gushyirwa; buri bimwe bikorwa nk’uko him cyangwa her, na ‘ello’ nk’uko it.

Mu Icyongereza, inyuma y’umubare, imyaka y’ibyo gushyirwa bikoreshwa: I see her, ntijywe I see she. Remera: umubare = she/he/they; ibyo gushyirwa = her/him/them.

title: Frequency Adverbs / Ibyo bifuza umwanya
bridge: Mu igifaransa, ibyo bifuza umwanya nk' 'siempre' cyangwa 'nunca' bikorwa inyuma y'umwuga ('Siempre como fruta'), ariko mu Icyongereza harimo amabwiriza yihuse yeze: bigomba kuba inyuma y'umwuga w'ingenzi ('I always eat fruit') ariko inyuma y'umwuga 'to be' ('I am always happy'). Nanone, mu igifaransa dutanga 'nunca' bitagomba gutanga ubwenge, ariko mu Icyongereza 'never' bitagombwa kugirwa na 'don't'.
rule: Ibyo bifuza umwanya mu Icyongereza (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) bifuza gutanga umwanya w'ibintu. Bikorwa: 1) Inyuma y'umwuga w'ingenzi: 'She often reads.' 2) Inyuma y'umwuga 'to be' (am/is/are): 'He is always late.' 3) Hati umubare n'umwuga mu ibibazo n'ibyo bitagombwa: 'Do you usually drink coffee?' 'I don't often go out.' Ibikorwa: 'sometimes' na 'usually' bikorwa ku mwishura cyangwa ku buryanshuro bwo gutanga ubwenge: 'Sometimes I walk to work' / 'I walk to work sometimes'. 'Never', 'rarely' na 'seldom' bigomba kuba bishize, bityo bitagombwa kugirwa na 'not'. Na 'never', umwuga w'ingenzi waba afite ubwenge: 'I never smoke' (nti 'I don't never smoke'). Mu ibyishushanyo bikorwa, bikorwa inyuma y'umubare: 'Yes, I usually do'.

title: Prepositions of Time / Ibyo bishushanyije b’igihe
bridge: Mu gaciriyano, ibyo bishushanyije b’igihe (at, in, on) bifite imikorere yagombaye yongeye atari nk’iri mu ikinyarwanda. Uyu munshya, dusanga ‘on Monday’ (ku wa mbere yo mwezi) na ‘in the morning’ (mu gitondo), ariko ‘at night’ (mu rugendo). Ikinyarwanda ifasha ‘mu’ canke ‘ku’ mu buryo bungana, kandi ni byo kibazo. Kuga: mu gaciriyano, buri kinyabwenge kishushanyijwe na kindi kivuga igihe kinini: isaha (at), iminsi (on), na amezi/iminyaka/ibihaza (in).
rule: Mu gaciriyano, ibyo bishushanyije b’igihe bishushanya n’iyi nto: ‘at’ kugirwa mu isaha nini na mu bihe binini (at 5 o’clock, at midnight, at noon), ‘on’ kugirwa mu minsi na mu tariki (on Monday, on July 4th, on my birthday), na ‘in’ kugirwa mu bihe bishize mu munsi (usibye ‘at night’), amezi, iminyaka, ibihaza, na ibihaza binini (in the morning, in July, in 2024, in summer). Ntibishushanywa na ‘today’, ‘yesterday’, ‘tomorrow’, canke na ‘this’, ‘that’, ‘every’, adi. ‘At’ nashushanywa na imyaka iteganywe n’ijambo ‘day’ (at Christmas) ariko ‘on Christmas day’.

title: Conjunctions: and, but, or, because, when, if / Ibyivugwa: na, ariko, cyangwa, kubera, ubwo, n’ubwo
bridge: Mu gaciri, ibyivugwa birakora akazi nk’ubw’isihanu, ariko harimo ibyabibujije. Uyu munshiro, ‘but’ byuzwa kugira ngo bishyireho ubwibutsa, nk’uko ‘pero’ bikora, ariko mu gaciri ntibiyuzwa ‘but’ nyuma yo koma igishyira hasi ibyemezo byanditswe neza, kandi mu sihanu byakoreshwa. Nanone, ‘because’ na ‘when’ ntibikenera koma ubwo bava mu magambo yo hejuru, ubwibutsa bw’ibyo bikoreshwa mu sihanu. ‘If’ bishyiraho imibareho y’ubwenge, nk’uko ‘si’ bikora mu sihanu, ariko remera ko mu gaciri ntibikoreshwa imibareho y’ubwenge mu mibareho y’A2.
rule:
Mu gaciri, ibyivugwa bikoreshwa kugira ngo bigishye amagambo, ibyemezo cyangwa ibyemezo byanditswe neza. Ibyivugwa byakoreshwa nini ni: 
- ‘and’ (na) kugira ngo bishyireho amakuru.
- ‘but’ (ariko) kugira ngo bishyireho ubwibutsa.
- ‘or’ (cyangwa) kugira ngo bishyireho imibareho.
- ‘because’ (kubera) kugira ngo bishyireho impamvu cyangwa inguvu.
- ‘when’ (ubwo) kugira ngo bishyireho igihe.
- ‘if’ (n’ubwo) kugira ngo bishyireho imibareho.

Mu byemezo byanditswe neza, bikoreshwa koma mbere yo kwivugwa ubwo bigishye ibyemezo byanditswe neza (mu munshiro: ‘I like tea, but she likes coffee.’). Mu byemezo bikombe, koma ntibikenera. 

Imirongo ifite ubwoko: 
- ‘Because’ bikoreshwa kugira ngo buhungire ibibazo by’impamvu. Ntibikoreshwa ‘because’ ku mwishyuro wo ku wa mbere mu gaciri kigiye kuri, ariko bikoreshwa mu kwivuga k’umunsi.
- ‘When’ bikoreshwa kugira ngo bishyireho ibikorwa bifite igihe kirekire; bigenda ku mwishyuro cyangwa mu magambo.
- ‘If’ bishyiraho imibareho; mu mibareho yo ku mbere (n’ubwo + ubu, ubushake), ntibikoreshwa ‘will’ mu gihuye cy’ubwenge.

Ibikorwa: 
- ‘But’ ntibikoreshwa na ‘although’ hamwe, naho mu sihanu bikavuga ‘pero aunque’. Mu gaciri, bikoreshwa ibiri.
- ‘And’ bikoreshwa kugira ngo bigishye ibyemezo; mbere yo kwivugwa ro hejuru koma bigomba, ariko ni ibikorwa.
- Mu gaciri, ntibikoreshwa ‘that’ nk’ubwivugwa mu bi, ubwibutsa bw’ibyo bikoreshwa mu sihanu (que).

title: Present Perfect Basics / Uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu
bridge: Mu gaciri, dutegura uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu (naje gukura) kugirango dusobanukire ibintu by’inyuma bishoboye kugira ububiko mu muvuko. Mu Icyongereza, uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu (I have eaten) buri na ububiko bw’urupfu, ariko naho buri na ububiko bw’ubushakashatsi bw’ubuzima bwotegetswe n’igihe byashize, ibintu by’ubushakashatsi by’ubuzima byotegetswe n’igihe byashize, ibintu by’ubushakashatsi by’ubuzima byotegetswe n’igihe byashize, ibintu by’ubushakashatsi by’ubuzima byotegetswe n’igihe byashize. Ubundi bwokubiyobwa: mu Icyongereza, uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu ntibwigwa n’amagambo yo kuri buri kintu nk’‘yesterday’ cyangwa ‘last year’; mu bihe bitari bityo, uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu bwigwa. Shushanya ku mpande z’amagambo ‘already’, ‘just’ na ‘yet’, izaboneka neza mu Icyongereza.
rule: Uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu bukoresha umusaruro wa HAVE (have/has) + umubare w’ubushakashatsi w’umwanya. Kuri ubwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi, umubare w’ubushakashatsi ni ukuvuga neza (gutegura -ed: work -> worked). Kuri ubwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi, hari ubwoko bw’amagambo bwinshi (go -> gone, see -> seen). Bwigwa: 1) Kugirango tubanze kuri ubushakashatsi bw’ubuzima bwotegetswe n’igihe (e.g., I have visited Paris). 2) Kuri ibintu by’inyuma byashoboye kugira ububiko mu muvuko (e.g., I have lost my keys). 3) Na ‘already’ (byari), ‘just’ (byari by’ubushakashatsi), ‘yet’ (byari by’ubushakashatsi) mu ibiro n’ibyo bitari byo. 4) Na ‘for’ na ‘since’ kugirango tubanze kuri ubushakashatsi (e.g., I have lived here for 10 years). Mu ibiro, tubanza umusaruro ku mbanze: Have you finished? Mu ibyo bitari byo: I have not (haven't) finished. Remera ko na ‘yesterday’, ‘last week’ cyangwa ibindi, uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu ntibwigwa, ahubwo uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu bwigwa.

Kugirango tubanze kuri ikintu kishize mu muvuko, uburenganzira bw’ikintu gishize kuri buri kintu bwigwa (saw). N’ubwo wakoze ‘have seen’ ahabwo utanga ububiko bw’igihe, ni byo byiza kugirango tubanze kuri ubushakashatsi.

title: Imperatives (Affirmative and Negative) / Imperativo (afirmativo na negatibo)
bridge: Mu gihisipanyoli, imperativo ifite imiterere nyingi kuri tú, usted, nosotros, vosotros, cyangwa n'abandi. Mu gishinga, imperativo ni byinshi bishushanye: ubifuzamo igisubizo cya mbere k'umwuka, nta kindi wibwira. Uyu munsi, 'habla' (tú) na 'hable' (usted) mu gishinga ni 'speak'. Nanone, kugana, mu gishinga bifashishwa 'don't' + umwuka, kandi mu gihisipanyoli bifashishwa 'no' + imperativo. Kwigomeka: nta 'doesn't' ifashishwa n'amabwiriza; 'don't' ni ifashishwa kuri buri kintu.
rule: Imperativo mu gishinga ifitirwa n'umwuka mu myiterere yako (infinitivo igihagije 'to'). Ifashishwa kugabanira amabwiriza, amahame, ibyishamo cyangwa ibiganiro. Imibare: 'Open the door', 'Listen to me'. Kuri imperativo negatibo, 'don't' (cyangwa 'do not' mu buryo bw'umwuka) bifitirwa mbere y'umwuka wako: 'Don't open the door', 'Don't worry'. Nta cyo ubwoko bukwiye kuri umwe cyangwa abandi kandi nta cyo ubwoko bw'umwuka bwubwiye. 'Let's' + umwuka ubifashishwa kugabanira ibiganiro (e.g., 'Let's go'). Mu gishinga, hatarukana n'igihisipanyoli, imperativo ntibifashishwa kugabanira ibyishamo (nk'uko 'que te mejores'), kuri ibyo bifashishwa imiterere nyingi.

concept_examples.text: Open the window, please.

common_error.explanation: Abanyarwanda bashobora kushisha 'to' nyuma ya 'don't' kubera ubushishozwe bw'igihisipanyoli (nta kugana). Mu gishinga, nyuma ya 'don't' bifashishwa umwuka wako igihagije 'to'.

examples.note: Umwuka wako igihagije amabwiriza. Mu gihisipanyoli, ni 'siéntate' n'amabwiriza yihariye.
Imperativo afirmativo ni byinshi kuri tú na usted. Reba ko 'listen' ntibifashishwa 'to' mbere yako mu imperativo.
Umwuka 'come' ubifashishwa mu myiterere yako. Mu gihisipanyoli, 'venir' ifite imiterere nyingi, ariko mu gishinga ntifite.
Kugana, 'don't' bifashishwa mbere y'umwuka wako. Mu gihisipanyoli tufashisha 'no' + imperativo.
Naho 'be' ni umwuka w'ubwoko, mu imperativo negatibo 'don't be' ni ifashishwa.
Kibagirwa ko 'worry' ni umwuka w'ubwoko; 'to' ntibifashishwa.
'Let's' ni ubushishozwe bw'ijambo 'let us'. Bifashishwa kugabanira ibiganiro kuri ikizanukanya cyifite umuntu wiyumvira.
Mu gihisipanyoli tufashisha umwuka w'ubwoko (veamos) cyangwa 'vamos a ver', ariko mu gishinga tufashisha 'let's' + umwuka wako.
Uburyo bw'imperativo negatibo bw'ijambo 'let's' ni 'let's not + umwuka'. Ni ubushishozwe bw'uburyo bw'umwuka.

title: Count and Uncount Nouns / Imyaka y’ibintu bikorwa na ibintu bitakorwa
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, ububiko bw’ibintu bikorwa na ibintu bitakorwa bimeze, ariko ntibigomeka cyane. Uyu munshiro, tugomba ‘umusatsi’ kugira ngo tubyire ibyara by’umusatsi, nyamara mu Icyongereza ‘bread’ ni ikintu bitakorwa kandi atikorwa. Ubundi bubiko bukomeye: ibintu bitakorwa mu Icyongereza ntibitonderwa ‘a/an’ cyangwa ‘one’, ariko mu ikinyarwanda bimwe birashobora kutonderwa, nk’uko ‘una información’ mu Icyongereza ni ‘some information’.
rule: Mu Icyongereza, ibintu bikorwa (count nouns) birashobora kuba mu ishusho cyangwa mu ibice byatanzwe kandi birashobora kubyirwa (one apple, two apples). Ibintu bitakorwa (uncount nouns) ntibifite ibice byatanzwe kandi ntibishobora kubyirwa hasi (water, rice, information). Kugira ngo ubyire ibintu bitakorwa, ubishyura ‘some’, ‘any’, ‘much’, cyangwa imibare nk’uko ‘a glass of’ cyangwa ‘a piece of’. N’ibintu bikorwa ubishyura ‘a/an’ mu ishusho, ‘many’ mu ibice byatanzwe, na ‘few’ mu ibice byinshi. N’ibintu bitakorwa ubishyura ‘much’ na ‘little’. Imirimo y’imyaka ‘the’ irimo igikorwa kirekire, ariko imyaka itandukanye birahinduka: ‘a/an’ atiyongorwa n’ibintu bitakorwa. Ibikorwa: ibintu bimwe birashobora kuba bikorwa cyangwa bitakorwa kuringana no kuva mu munsi (e.g., ‘chicken’ kuba inyamaswa cyangwa kuba ikinyama).

title: Some na Any / Some na Any (na ibikorwa byabo)
bridge: Mu gaciri, ndetse na mu magambo yo gusaba cyangwa guhitamo, tubika 'ikintu', 'umwe' cyangwa 'nta kindi' kandi nta cyohereza hagati ya magambo yo kuba ari yo kwuka cyangwa yo gusaba. Mu Icyongereza, gutanga 'some' cyangwa 'any' bihereza kumagambo atangwa no ku buryo umuntu yishimiye. Ikibazo kikuye kuri abahungu bahu gucyongereza, ni ko bashaka gutumiza 'some' mu magambo yo gusaba na 'any' mu magambo yo kwuka, ariko mu Icyongereza, ibitekerezo byagombaga kuba bisanzwe kurushaho. Ubwo hejuru yabyo, 'any' mu magambo yo kwuka bishaka kuvuga 'ubundi buri kintu'.
rule: Tubika 'some' (na ibikorwa byayo: somebody, someone, something, somewhere) mu magambo yo kwuka no mu magambo yo gusaba ubwo dusaba cyangwa duhitamo kuri uburyo bwiza, cyangwa ubwo dusaba icyo dufite ubwenge yuko izahura. Tubika 'any' (na ibikorwa byayo: anybody, anyone, anything, anywhere) mu magambo yo kwuka no mu magambo yo gusaba yose, ndetse no mu magambo yo kwuka bishaka kuvuga 'ubundi buri kintu' cyangwa 'nta cyohereza'. Ibikorwa byagomba kugenzwa nka ibyo: something/anything, somebody/anybody, someone/anyone, somewhere/anywhere. Na ibyago, tubika 'some' na 'any' mu magambo yo kwuka no yo gusaba; na ibyahambaye, tubika 'some' cyangwa 'any' kugira ngo tubone icyo kintu kizahura. Ntidushobora gutumiza 'no' na 'any' mu magambo yo kwuka; tubika 'no' + ibyago cyangwa 'not... any'.

title: Much, Many, A lot of / Ibyangombwa
bridge: Mu gaciri, dusaba ‘mucho’ cyangwa ‘muchos’ kuringana ubwoko n’ububiko, ariko mu Icyongereza, gutanga ntambwe bigaragara kuringana ubwoko bwa nomero ari contable cyangwa incontable, si kuringana ubwoko. Ibiki bikaba bishobora gutuma ubwicanye ku mbanze, ariko ni byoroshye: ‘many’ byerekana ibintu ushobora kubibika (byerekanwa n’ibitabo), ‘much’ byerekana ibintu ntushobora kubibika (byerekanwa n’amazi), na ‘a lot of’ byerekana ubwoko bw’ibintu byombi. Ikibazo gihuye ni ukubika ‘much’ hagati y’ibyakozwe by’ubwoko bwa nomero ari contable mu by’omeke, ariko remera ko ‘much’ na ‘many’ bikoreshwa neza mu by’omeke n’ibibazo.
rule: Mu Icyongereza, ibyangombwa ‘much’, ‘many’ na ‘a lot of’ byerekana umubare. ‘Many’ bikoreshwa na nomero ziri contable mu bwoko bwa ibintu bishize (books, cars, friends). ‘Much’ bikoreshwa na nomero ziri incontable (water, time, money). Mu gaciri z’omeke, ni byatanze kugena ‘a lot of’ (cyangwa ‘lots of’ mu buryo bw’icyongereza kidutse) na nomero zombi. Mu by’omeke n’ibibazo, dusaba ‘much’ na ‘many’. ‘How much’ dusaba umubare w’ibintu by’ubwoko bwa nomero ari incontable (How much water?), na ‘how many’ dusaba umubare w’ibintu by’ubwoko bwa nomero ari contable (How many books?). Ntukoreshe ‘much’ cyangwa ‘many’ na nomero ziri mu bwoko bwa ibintu bimwe. Hari na amagambo menshi nk’ ‘too much’, ‘too many’, ‘so much’, ‘so many’. Mu by’omeke, ‘much’ ni by’ubwoko bw’icyongereza gihuye cyangwa kigaragara neza (There is much work). Ku mubare w’A2, ni byatanze kumenya neza uburyo bwo kugena mu byibazo n’iby’omeke, na kugena ‘a lot of’ mu by’omeke. Remera ko ‘much’ na ‘many’ ntibikoreshwa na ‘no’ mu buryo bubiri (koresha ‘not much’ cyangwa ‘not many’).

title: Relative Clauses: who, which, that / Ibanga ry’umuntu canke ikintu: who, which, that
bridge: Mu gaciri, dutegura ‘uwu’ kuri abantu no ku bintu, kandi hanyuma ‘uwu’ kuri abantu. Mu Icyongereza, ushaka gutega ‘who’ (abantu) na ‘which’ (bintu), nyamara ‘that’ bishobora kutegwa kuri buri wiwe mu ibanga rengi. Ibindi: mu Icyongereza, ijambo ry’umuntu canke ikintu ntirushobora kugombwa niba ari umusubirwa w’ibanga, ariko mu gaciri hanyuma yegombwa. Nanone, mu Icyongereza, ‘what’ atigombwa kuri ibanga (ibyo ari ubwoko bw’ibibi abahanga icyongereza bashobora kugira); ‘that’ canke ‘which’ ni yo dugombwa.
rule:
Ibanga ry’umuntu canke ikintu rikoreshwa kugabanurira ibintu bibiri kuri umuntu canke ikintu kimwe. Mu Icyongereza, dutegura:

- **who** kuri abantu (umusubirwa canke igikorwa) kandi, mu ururimi rw’ibinyoma, hanyuma kuri inyama z’amabara.
- **which** kuri bintu, inyama canke ibyifuzo.
- **that** dugombora kuri abantu no ku bintu, hasi mu ibanga ry’urugero (restrictive).

Urutonde rw’ibanga ni: [ijambo] + [ijambo ry’umuntu canke ikintu] + [ibanga].

Imisuso:
- The man **who** lives next door is a doctor. (Umuntu w’abagabo uvuze arakaza ni umubyeyi.)
- The book **which** I bought is interesting. (Igitabo nanjye narakuye ni cy’umwihariko.)
- The dog **that** barks a lot is mine. (Ingwe ifuza cyane ni jyanye.)

**Ibibi abahanga icyongereza bashobora kugira:**
- Ntukoreshe ‘what’ kuri ibanga (mu gaciri ‘qué’ hanyuma, ariko mu Icyongereza ‘what’ bikwiye ‘lo que’ kandi bigombwa gusa bitagombwa).
- Ntukagombe ‘who/which/that’ iyo ari umusubirwa, kubera ko ijambo ry’umusubirwa ryikizwa.
- Ubukumbuye ko mu Icyongereza urutonde ni umusubirwa + ijambo, ntushobora kugahungabanya nk’mu gaciri (e.g. ‘El hombre que vive aquí’ -> ‘The man who lives here’, ntukagire ‘The man who here lives’).

**Amasomo na n’ibindi:** Ntibifite amasomo. ‘That’ bishobora kugira abantu no ku bintu. ‘Who’ gusa abantu. ‘Which’ gusa bintu. Mu Icyongereza ya nyuma, ‘that’ ni cyane mu ururimi rw’ibinyoma, ariko ‘who’ na ‘which’ ni cyane cyane.
